summary: Fourth review round (delta round) at 18563a0a. The audited HEAD is current and provenance-bound. The delta b0bb87d4..18563a0a holds exactly the adversarial test commit b39b1c57 (tests only), the Green fix 2d1c875e, the evidence commit c2ab99b1, and the run-log commit 18563a0a. All five brief checks pass. Check 1 (PII strip): the separator change in lesson-context.ts:72 consumes horizontal space only after the label punctuation, so a bare label ends its clause at the newline; my old-vs-new comparison on regexes copied verbatim from lesson-context.ts:67-77 shows the six strip forms still remove (bare label, label plus value same line, label at end, CRLF, tab) and the label-before-math form now keeps the math line (the ADV-S3-5 fix). The accepted limit is documented in the test and evidence.md r5b: a value on the line after a bare label now survives the clause strip, but real account PII still leaves through the knownDetails loop (lesson-context.ts:91-95), which both routes feed (BM2 route.ts:188 passes session.username and session.sub; IM3 route.ts:215 passes displayName, email, username, id). The BM2 PII release gate passed 5 of 5 in my heavy-run, the BM2 S3 fix group (including ADV-S3-5) passed 3 of 3, and the IM3 no-PII plus S3-fix groups passed 8 of 8. Check 2 (structured debug output): the pre-fix structured path passed no debugLogger, and the SDK falls back to raw console when OPENROUTER_DEBUG is on (node_modules/@openrouter/sdk/esm/lib/sdks.js:60-61), so the fix closes a real Authorization-header leak; the moved logger redacts every object argument to [body redacted] (debug-logger.ts:44-47), header strings keep the configured key forms redacted (debug-logger.ts:17-37), retry.ts adds no logging, providers.ts:41-77 keeps HTTP errors status-only with redactApiKey on error text, and the ADV-S3-8 test (green in my full package run, 165 of 165) proves key, prompt, and answer absent on the wire-verified success path while retry and error paths reuse the same redacting logger. Check 3 (chat path): the chat path imports the same shared logger; the object-body change makes chat debug output strictly quieter, and the round-2 chat redaction test still passes. Check 4 (no new export): debug-logger.ts is absent from package.json exports and from src/index.ts re-exports. Check 5 (gates.sh key()): my sourced-gates.sh probe proves FAIL, AssertionError, and TS lines stay in the key while usage-record lines drop; failure detection stays exit-code driven first, so the filter hides no real failure. A2 is not applicable (no draft-to-published flip in the delta). The registry and evidence.md r5b claim nothing beyond what I verified. No blocking finding stands, so the gate passes.

Check 2, the pre-fix leak: structured.ts previously created the client without a debugLogger (the delta adds only that line at structured.ts:154), and the SDK falls back to raw console when OPENROUTER_DEBUG is set (node_modules/@openrouter/sdk/esm/lib/sdks.js:60-61), so the structured path printed the Authorization header before the fix. 2d1c875e closes it.

Check 2, redaction surface: sdks.js:234-294 logs header values as strings (redactApiKey replaces the raw key, the trimmed key, and the bearer-stripped token, all length >= 8, debug-logger.ts:17-37) and request or response bodies as objects (replaced with '[body redacted]', debug-logger.ts:44-47). Usage records carry role, model, latency, tokens, outcome, status only (usage-log.ts:12-26). retry.ts has no console output, so the retry path reuses the same redacting logger per attempt. The error path keeps HTTP errors status-only and applies redactApiKey to error text (providers.ts:41-77); route handlers log role plus status only (BM2 lesson-chatbot route catch, IM3 route catch). The ADV-S3-8 test ran green in my full package heavy-run (165 of 165) and asserts the wire header is 'Bearer <KEY>' while the captured console output holds no key, prompt, or answer.

Check 3, chat path: providers.ts imports the same debugLoggerFor from ./debug-logger (providers.ts:12); the only chat-path behavior change is that object arguments now print '[body redacted]' instead of key-redacted JSON, which removes prompts and answers from chat debug output too. The round-2 chat redaction test (finding e N1) still passes in the full package run.

Check 5: sourced the real gates.sh and ran key() on a synthetic log (scratch script scratch-key-test.sh, deleted after use). FAIL, AssertionError, and TS2322 lines stay in the key; both the raw '[ai-tutoring] request ...' line and the 'stdout | ' framed one drop. gates.sh detects a new failure first by exit code (gates.sh:118-123), and key() only refines the case where baseline and current share a nonzero exit code, so a genuine new failure always surfaces through FAIL/AssertionError/TS lines or the exit code. The filter is fixed-string and line-anchored, so no error message containing the phrase mid-line is dropped.
